title: Bee Landed event (rizzstack.bee-landed/1)
description: A CloudEvents 1.0 envelope that announces one terminal worker transition: succeeded, failed or cancelled. A Bee Landed event is delivery evidence. It is not a verification result and it is not an acceptance decision; those belong to the receiver.

specversion.description: CloudEvents specification version. Only 1.0 is implemented.

id.description: Event id: a UUID (canonical text form) or a URN. Unique per emitted event.

source.description: URI-reference naming the emitting coordinator or adapter. It is an identity, never a filesystem path.

type.description: CloudEvents type of the canonical Bee Landed event.

time.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the terminal transition.

subject.description: The worker task or attempt this event is about, in the emitter's stable naming.

datacontenttype.description: Optional CloudEvents attribute; when present it must describe the JSON data payload.

dataschema.description: Optional CloudEvents attribute naming the schema URI.

schema.description: Payload schema version. tools/bee_landed.py refuses any other value.

terminal_transition_id.description: Optional durable id of the terminal transition. When omitted, the dedupe key uses the CloudEvents id instead.

identity.description: The coordinator identity that observed and emitted the terminal transition.

session.description: Optional coordinator session id. It is an id, never a credential.

harness.description: The agent harness or runner that executed the attempt.

model.description: Optional model identifier reported by the harness.

state.description: Terminal landing state. Missing, non-terminal and receiver-side states (verified, accepted) are refused.

source_rev.description: Lowercase git revision (40 hex) or sha256 revision (64 hex) the attempt ran against.

sha256.description: Digest of the lease the coordinator granted.

items.description: Repository-relative file path. Absolute paths, traversal and home-directory paths are refused.

available.description: Whether a result artifact exists for a receiver to reproduce. A true value requires artifact_sha256 or reference.

artifact_sha256.description: Digest of the artifact. The artifact bytes never travel in this event.

reference.description: Pointer a receiver can resolve to fetch the artifact. It is a reference, never embedded content.

correlation_id.description: Optional id shared by all events in one workflow correlation.

causation_id.description: Optional id of the event or command that caused this landing.

$comment: CloudEvents extension attributes are permitted at the envelope root. The data object is closed: no producer-defined payload fields are allowed.
